title: NYC’s three tallest crash peaks: 2nd Ave at 39th St, Broadway at Flushing Ave, and 125th St in Harlem
description: A 3D landscape of every crash in 2023–2025 that injured or killed a pedestrian or cyclist in New York City. Each spot's height is the number of crashes within 100 m of it, so the hills are where crashes cluster. Drag to turn the city and hover for the nearest intersection.
